title: feat(plugin-auth): the environment-access refusal carries the host's reason and sentence
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9UbbSUQWB2j9eHYsRcrCiq1X1C)_

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:云端拒绝某账号进入环境时,宿主可以说明原因(「不是该组织成员」「邀请尚未接受」)和一句给用户看的话;这个原因经环境自己的登录回调一路带到环境登录页,登录页按原因显示对应的本地化句子。应用把用户送来登录时,登录页显示「登录以继续前往 应用名」,而不再只显示对方的域名。
- 为什么改:cloud#4471 的托管登录需要告诉用户为什么进不去、该怎么做,也需要让用户知道自己正在登录哪个应用。
- 风险与回滚:宿主仍返回 true/false 时,三种拒绝回复与改动前逐字节一致(有测试钉住),谁能进入没有任何变化。新增一个无需登录的只读接口,只回答应用名,而且只回答已签名请求里点名的那个应用,其余情况一律同一个 404,并按来源地址限流(每 60 秒 10 次)。回滚即还原本 PR;云端只有在用上本版本 plugin-auth 之后才能返回原因对象。
- 先看:`packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/oauth-client-name.ts`(新接口的放行条件)、`oauth-callback-refusal-reason.ts`(回调上带原因的条件)、`ui/apps/console/src/pages/auth/LoginPage.tsx`(登录页的两处读取)。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-auth exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/oauth-authorize-refusal.test.ts`,预期 69 个测试全部通过。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

Fixes #34168

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

## What changes

All four items of the card.

- **The seam may say why (item 1).** `AuthManagerOptions.oidcAuthorizeGate` may answer `OidcAuthorizeGateRefusal` (`{ allowed: false, reason, message }`) in place of `false`. An object refuses only when it says `allowed: false`; every other answer keeps the truthiness the gate was always read with, so nothing changes who is admitted.
- **The refusal carries it (item 2)**, on each door `oauth-authorize-refusal.ts` already chooses between:
  - the `403` envelope keeps `code: ENV_ACCESS_DENIED`, gains `reason`, and its `message` is the host's sentence;
  - the redirect back to a registered `redirect_uri` keeps `error=access_denied` (RFC 6749 §4.1.2.1), sends the host's sentence as `error_description`, and adds `objectstack_error_reason`;
  - the readable page shows the host's sentence, HTML-escaped, after the signed-in account.
- **Nothing the host answers is trusted.** A reason outside `[a-z_]{1,40}` is dropped and the refusal stands. A sentence with a control character or an angle bracket, or longer than 300 characters, is replaced by the fixed sentence. On the redirect only, a sentence outside the character set RFC 6749 §4.1.2.1 allows for `error_description` (printable ASCII without the double quote and the backslash) is also replaced by the fixed sentence.
- **Why `objectstack_error_reason`.** RFC 6749 §8.2 asks an extension parameter that is not registered to carry a vendor prefix, so it cannot collide with a registered name. The card's example, `error_reason`, is not free: some identity providers already send it with their own values.
- **The reason reaches the environment's sign-in page (item 3).** The environment's OAuth callback (`GET /callback/:id`) rebuilds its error redirect from `error` and `error_description` only. One after-hook, `carryRefusalReasonOnCallback` (`oauth-callback-refusal-reason.ts`, called from `auth-manager-after-hook.ts`), puts the reason back on that redirect. It acts only when all of these hold: a `GET` of the platform identity provider's callback; the request's own query says `error=access_denied` and carries exactly one reason of the validated shape; the callback answered a redirect whose query says `error=access_denied` and carries no reason yet. The rest of the location is kept byte for byte. The organization's name is not a field anywhere: it travels only inside the host's sentence.
- **The Console's sentences (item 3).** `ssoCallbackRefusalMessage` takes the reason: `not_member` and `invitation_pending` get their own sentences, under `access_denied` only. An unknown reason, no reason, or a reason beside another error code keeps today's sentence. Three keys are added in all eleven packs (real translations; zh-Hant regenerated by `gen:zh-hant`): `auth.login.errors.ssoAccessDeniedNotMember`, `auth.login.errors.ssoAccessDeniedInvitationPending`, `auth.login.ssoHandoffClient`.
- **The application's name on a hand-off (item 4).** The sign-in page reads the client name only for the client its signed request names. New route `GET /api/v1/auth/oauth2/client-name?client_id=CLIENT_ID&oauth_query=SIGNED_QUERY` (`oauth-client-name.ts`, mounted in `auth-plugin.ts`, ledgered in `auth-route-ledger.ts` as `public`):
  - `oauth_query` must carry a signature this server made and that has not expired, checked by the provider's own `verifyOAuthQueryParams`; the session is never read;
  - the client is the single `client_id` inside the verified request, and the URL's `client_id` must equal it;
  - the answer is `{ client_name }` and nothing else of the client;
  - a signature that does not verify or has expired, a mismatched `client_id`, an unknown client, a disabled client and a client with no name all answer the same `404`; a parameter outside the closed set, a repeated one or a missing one answers `400`;
  - it is rate-limited per client address (ADR-0121 D6), counted before anything is read; over the limit it answers `429` `RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED` with `Retry-After`.
  `LoginPage` asks it once on a signed hand-off and shows "Sign in to continue to NAME"; any other answer (refusal, network failure, another body shape, no signed request on the URL) keeps "Continue to HOST".
- **The registered-`redirect_uri` rule is unchanged**: the redirect is followed exactly when it was before.

## Tests

- `packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/oauth-authorize-refusal.test.ts`, over the file's real-`AuthManager` harness (real better-auth, the real oauth-provider):
  - items 1 and 2 as in round 1: the boolean CONTROL (envelope body, redirect parameters in order, page SHA-256 equal to the merge base's), reason and sentence pins on each door, the admitted set unchanged, the resume pass;
  - the client-name read: the matched client is served exactly `{ success: true, data: { client_name } }`; a mismatched `client_id` is refused and the other client's name never appears; an unknown client, a disabled client, a signed request whose `client_id` was changed, and an expired one each get the same refusal as a mismatch; three malformed requests answer `400`; the window's reads from one address answer, the next is refused with `429`, `RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED`, `Retry-After` and `no-store`, and another address still answers;
  - the callback carry: an environment `AuthManager` with the platform identity provider and a second one, fed the provider's real refusal parameters. The reason lands on `/_console/login` beside `error` and `error_description`; CONTROL: a boolean refusal lands with no reason; not carried for a reason of another shape, a reason beside another error, a reason from the other identity provider, or two reasons.
- `auth-route-ledger.conformance.test.ts`: the new route in the objectstack list.
- Console: `LoginPage.access-denied-32992.test.tsx` gains a describe for the two reasons, an unknown reason and a reason beside another code. New `LoginPage.handoff-client-name-34168.test.tsx`: the name is shown and asked with the URL's client and the whole signed request; the host line stays on a 404, a network failure and a body of another shape; CONTROL: no signed request, nothing asked.

<details><summary>Ablations (each mutation landed on disk through scripts/ablation-replace.mjs; every restore read blob == HEAD and git diff HEAD empty; the subjects resolve from src, no build between legs)</summary>

| Ablation (round 2, at `fb0d4b052`) | Result |
|:--|:--|
| client-name: URL `client_id` no longer has to equal the signed one | 1 failed (the mismatch pin) |
| client-name: disabled check removed | 1 failed (disabled) |
| client-name: signature verification removed | 1 failed (expired) |
| callback: platform-provider check removed | 1 failed (other identity provider) |
| callback: reason shape check removed | 1 failed (reason of another shape) |
| callback: exactly-one-reason check loosened | 1 failed (two reasons) |
| callback: both `access_denied` checks removed (request held, redirect ablated) | 1 failed (reason beside another error) |
| Console: reason read under any error code | 1 failed (reason beside another code) |
| Console: client-name body shape loosened | 1 failed (body of another shape) |
| client-name: rate limit removed (round 3, at `749c7a2ca`) | 1 failed (the rate-limit pin: expected 200 to be 429) |

Round 1 (items 1 and 2) ablations stand as reported there: reason pattern 6 failed, sentence markup 2, sentence length 1, RFC charset 1, object truthiness 1, page escape 1.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- A host may return the refusal object only once it runs this plugin-auth release or later: an older plugin-auth reads any object as truthy, which admits. The changeset says so.
- The new route is rate-limited per client address: a fixed window of 10 reads per 60 seconds, counted before anything is read, in the kernel `cache` service when one is registered, as the signed-out invitation preview is (ADR-0121 D6). Over the limit it answers `429` `RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED` with `Retry-After` and `Cache-Control: no-store`.
- The new route is an unauthenticated door, which ADR-0138 D2 asks to be recorded in an ADR amendment; `docs/adr/**` is outside this card's file surface, so that note is left to the seat.
- The callback carry covers the `GET` callback. A provider that answers by `form_post` reaches `POST /callback/:id`, which the vendor re-issues as a `GET` rebuilt from its own known fields, so the reason would not survive that hop. The platform identity provider answers by query redirect, so this path is not exercised today.
- The new types (`OidcAuthorizeGateRefusal` and the rest) are exported from their modules, not re-exported from the package index.
- No `packages/spec/src/**` file is touched.

## Verification

`yes (widening)` holds: the gate option's return type widens, the envelope gains an optional `reason`, the redirects gain an optional parameter, one public, rate-limited read route is added, and three i18n keys are added. Nothing narrows: a boolean answer is byte-identical, and every existing route answers as before.
